Leterrier2024.inherited_input: The displayed Gram defines the rank-54 narrow Mordell-Weil lattice, of minimum10 and determinant3^25. The paper computationally constructs the Gram; its minimum theorem is inherited, not re-enumerated.

53D_review_finding: No stronger published 53D lower bound located; Vardy1999 pp278-279 reports E54 lamination and bounds in57-63D, not a stronger53D number. Our explicit dual normal replaces the conservative Hermite-only section evaluation.
